name: Patrick de Jong
story: Patrick de Jong studied forest science at the Australian National University from 2012 to 2015. His professional profile records work with CarbonCrop and volunteer service as a firefighter and GIS analyst with Fire and Emergency New Zealand. His forestry mapping therefore sits alongside practical work in environmental information and emergency response.
Patrick de Jong presented Esri field applications in forestry in 2018.
